description: For every interpreted function symbol \(g\) and tuple \(\bar a\) from \(M\), the signed diagram contains \(g(c_{\bar a})=c_{g^M(\bar a)}\). This includes \(d=c_{d^M}\) for each original constant \(d\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.signedDiagram_function_fact.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] {n : ℕ} (g : L.Functions n) (a : Fin n → M) :
  (FirstOrder.Language.func (Sum.inl g) fun i => (L.con (a i)).term).equal
      (L.con (FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap g a)).term ∈
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.signedDiagram L M
